Ever dreamed of having an ice cream shop? Strawberry, chocolate, or even chili flavor... It all depends on you!  Get dressed with chef’s apron and hat, and prepare for your ice cream bars! The most abundant flavors and the most interesting production are all in the Little Panda’s Ice Cream Bars.

ICE CREAM MAKING
In little panda’s ice cream shop, you can make however you want! Choose ingredients and create your-style ice cream, design special and cute shapes of your ice cream bars! 

TOPPING DECORATION
With nine different toppings to choose from, you can decorate your ice cream bar with a layer of yummy toppings and chocolate sprinkles before sending it to the freezer!

PACKAGING AND SELLING
Wrap your colorful ice cream bars in beautiful bags! Now you can sell them to your little customers! Look! The customers are lining up, and they can’t wait to buy your delicious ice cream bar!

FEATURES
- Tons of yummy flavors and toppings to choose from. 
- Lots of adorable shapes and sticks for ice cream bars. 
- Various beautiful packing bags are waiting. 
- Super easy to operate ice-cream machines.
- Enjoy the fun of being a dessert chef!
- Different reactions of every customer depending on what you make!

Come on! Turn on the switch, and start to make ice cream bars! You will get the very skill of making the most yummy ice cream bar in little panda’s Ice Cream shop!
